Our Thursday Green Deals this week has a nice mix of deals across EVs, power stations, security systems, and tools, starting with Velotric’s FREE $550 extra battery bundle on the Nomad 2 Off-Road e-bike at $1,999 that gives it up to 130 miles of travel range. Alongside the new $665 low on Bluetti’s Pioneer Na(Sodium) Power Station , you can also find it bundled with an alternator charger for an exclusive $854 low . There’s also a one-day-only chance to score 2x Anker eufyCam C37 Solar Security Cameras bundled with a HomeBase 3 at $260 , as well as Amazon savings on Hiboy’s DK1, DK2, and DM14 Electric Dirt Bikes for kids up to 14 years old starting from $300 . We also have ongoing Prime deals for Worx’s 8A 2-in-1 chainsaw/pole saw combo tool, the 24V Greenworks 8-inch pole saw kit, and more. And don’t forget about the hangover deals from this week at the bottom of the page, like the yesterday’s Lectric XPress Lite e-bike $1,099 launch, snow blower deals from EGO and Greenworks , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
FREE $550 extra battery takes Velotric’s Find My-equipped Nomad 2 off-road e-bike up to 130 miles
Among Velotric’s current lineup of e-bike deals , the brand is once again offering the chance to score a $550 FREE extra battery with the Nomad 2 Off-Road Fat Tire e-bike for $1,999 shipped . While there is no price cut on the e-bike itself, the deal here is the biggest amount of savings we’ve tracked on this model, being a repeat of the bundle we saw in September. Past discounts have only ever trimmed the price on the e-bike down to $1,749 at most, so the $550 savings you’re getting here for double the travel range makes it a far better deal for folks who really want to be able to go the distance.
You can learn about the Nomad 2 e-bike’s capabilities with this bundle here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Exclusive Bluetti code delivers ‘4,000+ cycle’ 900Wh Pioneer Na(Sodium) station with alternator charger 1 for $854 (Reg. $999)
***Note: Bluetti’s website seems to be having some issues for this bundle’s landing page, but you can add it to your cart from the main sale page here (scroll down to find it) to bypass the technical difficulties – just be sure to use the exclusive code below at checkout.
As part of Bluetti’s ongoing Fall Prime Deals Encore Sale , we spotted a first-time bundle offer for the recently returned Pioneer Na(Sodium) Portable Power Station with an Alternator Charger 1 down at $854.05 shipped , after using the code 9TO5TOYS5OFF at checkout. The standalone power station hit the market back in October 2025, and has yet to make an appearance on Amazon, with the bundles we’ve seen for it only having ever mixed in varying solar panel sizes. This is a first-time offer with a $999 MSRP, which you would have had to previously pay anywhere from $934 to $1,298 to buy both the station and charger 1 separately until this sale. Now, with our exclusive bonus savings code, you’ll get a combined $145 markdown for the best price to date. You can also grab the standalone power station at a new $665 exclusive low .
You can learn all about this Bluetti Pioneer Na(Sodium) bundle here , or check out the full Encore Sale lineup here .
Bundle two Anker eufyCam C37 solar security cameras with a HomeBase 3 for $260 (Reg. $400, Today only)
As part of Best Buy’s Deals of the Day , Anker is offering a new bundle of the eufyCam C37 Wireless Solar Security 2-Cam kit with HomeBase 3 at $259.99 shipped . Down from $400, while the HomeBase 3 has been on the market for a while, the cameras only launched back at the beginning of April, with the only bundle we’ve seen available until now being the 2x cameras with a HomeBase Mini . There was a one-time chance to separately get 2x cameras and a HomeBase 3 for as low as $250 last week during Prime Day, with the deal here being the next-best option at $140 off, which matches the price you’d have separately paid back during June’s Prime event.
You can get the rundown on what to expect from this Anker eufyCam C37 bundle here .
Hiboy’s DK series + DM14 mini electric dirt bikes are at some of their best prices from $300
Amazon currently has a mix of kid-friendly Hiboy EV deals running right now for your children up to 14 years old – and stock is running low. Things start with the DK2 Electric Dirt Bike for Kids Age 3-7 down at $299.97 shipped , beating out Hiboy’s direct website pricing by $40 . While it carries a $610 MSRP directly, at Amazon it typically goes for $340 at full price, though there have been occasional bumps higher to $355 at the most this year. Last week’s Prime Day event saw it fall to a $285 low, with the deal here being the next-best rate we have tracked for those that missed out. You can also find the DK1 Electric Dirt Bike for Kids Age 3-10 down at $359.95 shipped (beating the direct website by $39 ), or the DM14 48V Electric Dirt Bike for Kids Age 8-14 down at a $539.98 low , which is completly sold out directly .
You can learn about the differences between these three kid-friendly EVs here .
Get more affordable 2-in-1 cutting with Worx’s 8A chainsaw + pole saw down at $84 (Reg. $100)
Amazon is offering the Worx 8A 2-in-1 Chainsaw/Pole Saw down at $83.99 shipped that is carrying over from Prime Day last week. This model started the year off at a $130 full price, which dropped to $120 by March, and further to $100 by mid-September, where it fell from at the start of last week’s big savings event. The deal is continuing past the event now for an unknown time more, giving you an extended opportunity to pick it up at the second-lowest price we have tracked this year, just $4 above the low last seen in the first week of September.
There’s still time to add Greenwork’s 24V 8-inch cordless pole saw to your arsenal down at a $100 low
Amazon has an ongoing budget-friendly deal leftover from Prime Day on the Greenworks 24V 8-inch Cordless Electric Pole Saw with a 2.0Ah battery down at $99.99 shipped . While it carries a $160 MSRP directly from Greenworks, it’s been down from a $150 Amazon full price to $110 for a few months, with the price falling further to this same rate during last week’s Prime Day event. You’re getting a prolonged opportunity at $60 total savings from the MSRP for the all-time lowest price we have tracked.
Save up to $312 on Anker’s latest solar Wall Light Cam S4 or multi-packs with HomeBase 3 starting from a new $170 low
